skill_name: What kind of impact has social media had on the way people communicate?
workflow: Social media has had a huge impact on the way people communicate. It has allowed us to stay connected to people around the world easily and quickly, no matter how far apart we are. People can communicate with each other instantly and share things in an instant, without having to wait for mail to arrive.
